crossRefs.note: For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth:
My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.
Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your…
You will groan at your latter end, when your flesh and your body are consumed,
The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.
He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.
They will not lie with the mighty who are fallen of the uncircumcised, who have gone down to Sheol with their weapons…
They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them.
The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.

Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go…
I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.”

translations.web: His bones are full of his youth, but youth will lie down with him in the dust.
translations.bsb: The youthful vigor that fills his bones will lie down with him in the dust.
translations.kjv: His bones are full of the sin of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.
translations.asv: His bones are full of his youth, But it shall lie down with him in the dust.
